# Original generic cockpit asset rights

The original cockpit is authored by Flight Simulator contributors and licensed under the repository MIT license. Retain `third_party/licenses/notices/FirstParty-Interactive-MIT.txt` unchanged in the package and associate it with `original-prototype-cockpit-v1`.

The geometry preserves the independently captured existing generic prototype builder: 74 parts, seven imported shared materials, fixed eye/control markers, and two original 256x256 surface tiles. The source generator creates the tile patterns from project code. No manufacturer drawing, manual, photograph, logo, borrowed texture or downloaded model is included. This is not a Cessna geometry or calibrated sight-picture claim.

Blender 4.5.14 LTS is the authoring tool. Its software license does not replace the original output's MIT grant. The output source bundle retains the exact generator, original PNGs, `.blend`, design reference, generation provenance and README; the runtime bundle retains the matching GLB and fixed resource adapter. Matching hashes, complete inventory, original material/image sharing and actual import evidence are delivery gates. A filename or this rights statement alone does not establish an output's origin.

The accepted specification is `docs/contracts/cockpit/original-asset-v1.md`, merged in `5e7f6042a8a5f313d0bb58d0abb7b0106ae125ad`. Actual export/import checks and three-context pixel review are recorded separately in `docs/evidence/P2/original-cockpit-asset.md`. The broad cockpit, aircraft fidelity, hardware, pilot and phase gates remain open.
